definitions.explanation: The name given to a book, movie, article, song, or other creative work.

examples.japanese: この{本|ほん}の{題名|だいめい}は{何|なん}ですか。
examples.english: What is the title of this book?

examples.japanese: {題名|だいめい}を{見|み}て{内容|ないよう}を{想像|そうぞう}した。
examples.english: I imagined the content based on the title.

examples.japanese: {映画|えいが}の{題名|だいめい}が{思|おも}い{出|だ}せない。
examples.english: I can't remember the title of the movie.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- {題名|だいめい}: Title of a creative work (book, movie, song)
- タイトル: Title (loanword, widely used)
- {題|だい}: Title, topic, subject (broader meaning)
- {件名|けんめい}: Subject line (email)
- {表題|ひょうだい}: Title, heading (more formal)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {題名|だいめい}をつける (to give a title)
- {題名|だいめい}を{考|かんが}える (to think of a title)
- {題名|だいめい}のない{作品|さくひん} (untitled work)
